A.notes: A has one strong idea: a journey/line from house to room, breakfast and walks, and it carries through the whole page with unusual discipline. The typography is the identity and the scroll-strip shows motion progressing section by section in a way that serves the brief, not just decoration. It also clears the measured accessibility checks; only some oversized spacing/pinning on mobile keeps Craft from a perfect score.

hard_gate_failures: Body text contrast under 4.5:1 (1 measured color-contrast failure)
B.notes: B has a clear door-based signature and a calm, coherent visual system, with rooms and booking presented plainly. The motion evidence is modest: some illustration/parallax progression and a rooftop skyline moment, but it reads more generic than narrative from the scroll frames. It is disqualified by the measured contrast failure despite otherwise solid keyboard and reduced-motion basics.

raw.why: A is the stronger design and the valid run: its line-and-station concept is more original, more fully carried through, and its motion directly reinforces the hotel’s arrival/walks story.
